newsitem.title: IRAN: Iranian commissions 5 mln T/year iron ore mine.
newsitem.headline: Iranian commissions 5 mln T/year iron ore mine.

text.p: Iran on Monday commissioned an iron ore mine with an expected yearly output of 5 million tonnes, state-run Tehran radio said.
It said President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani inaugurated the Chadormalou mine built in central Yazd province for $582 million in hard cash and 380 billion rials ($126.7 million).
The mine, with deposits of 400 million tonnes, employs more than 1,000 people, the radio added.
Iranian officials have said it was built by local contractors and companies from Japan, Sweden and Germany without giving further details.
Iran has said its steel production reached 6 million tonnes in the Iranian year which ended on March 20, up from 4.3 million tonnes the previous year. ($1=3,000 rials at the official exchange rate)
